description: Send quote or pricing sheet lines as JSON; returns flags for mismatched line totals, wrong discount amounts, subtotal errors and tier range conflicts. Math only. Process-and-discard: nothing is stored or logged after the run. A request containing a Luhn-valid card number or a valid IBAN is refused before accept with reason sensitive_data_refused (not counted as a check). Free plan: runs under the shared free check cap. Desk: volume use.

api_key.description: Optional key (vdk_...). Same as the Bearer header.

currency.description: Optional currency code (e.g. GBP). Carried through but not used in arithmetic checks.

discount.description: Optional discount block: rate_pct (number, 0-100), base (string label, e.g. 'subtotal'), amount (number).

lines.description: Quote lines. Each line should have line_id, qty, unit_price, and line_total.

subtotal.description: Optional stated subtotal; checked against sum of line totals.

tiers.description: Optional quantity tiers. Each tier needs min_qty (int), max_qty (int or null), unit_price (number). Checked for overlaps and gaps.

total.description: Optional stated total after discount; checked against subtotal minus discount.

name: check_quote_math
title: Check quote or pricing sheet arithmetic
